definitions.error_bars: min-max across 3 per-run values; not confidence intervals
definitions.p95_mean: arithmetic mean of the 3 per-run p95 values, not a pooled p95
definitions.rate_aggregation: arithmetic mean of per-run percentages; totals are sums
definitions.waiting_sessions: arithmetic mean of instantaneous measure samples; not total wait events or wait time
definitions.phase_labels: request phase gate is exact; SQL/resource measure labels follow received logs and are approximate
definitions.resource_aggregation: mean of measure samples within each run, then mean/min/max across 3 runs
definitions.cpu_quota: Docker CPUPerc divided by configured vCPU quota; host CPU/RAM not included
